title: Opening and Ray Lopez's birth in the French Quarter
summary: Recording starts; Lopez gives his birth date in 1889 and his French Quarter birthplace.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I'm Raymond Lopez. I was born down in New Orleans in November of 1889. 1889? In fact, I was born on Thanksgiving Day. I used to get froze out on my birthday. My mother would say, well, don't worry, we'll have your birthday, Thanksgiving Day. And I fooled around, went to public schools, graduated from the Western Union.
What part of town were you born?
I was born down on Domaine Street.
In the French Quarter, Domaine between Dolphin and Bourbon.
